title: 第688章 班师回朝第687章 渡化萨克多
slug: 被贬废丹房我偷偷无敌了
content_zh:
陈长生看着钱多多，心中也很是震惊，这么一尊大高手，被渡化之后居然变得这么虔诚，一脸忏悔的模样。
恐怕修炼了数十年的佛修都没有这么虔诚吧，这才知道佛门功法的霸道与高深莫测，以后要是遇到一定要多加小心。
不过收服了这么一名大高手让陈长生心中大喜，他身边又多了一名顶尖高手。
“钱多多，你以后就坐镇长生殿之中，帮我应对强敌。”
“是，主人，我一定好好帮助主人，早日洗脱我的罪孽。”
从长生殿出来，已经是天光大亮，太阳从天边刚露出小半个脑袋，暖金色的光辉照在死亡城之上，增添了几分温暖。
院子里的梧桐树叶子已经微微发黄，带来了几分秋意。
“邪月先生，您终于出关了，四殿下以及大帅让您出关后去议事大厅。”陈长生刚刚出来，就有人上前说道。
“好！”
陈长生一步踏出已经进了大殿之中。
马大帅一脸兴奋，“先生真是神机妙算，火罗国大军果然连夜退走了，而且把所有火鳞马都留了下来，我们的军士已经把火鳞马全部牵了过来。”
四皇子点点头也是一脸兴奋，“这次我们大胜，得到了二十多万匹火鳞马，这是天大的功劳！”
他没想到这次来这么顺利，几乎没有费什么力气就取得了这么大的胜利，当然了，这都是因为有陈长生这个大佬。
陈长生点点头，“这个我已经知道了，火罗国中路大军已经退回到大楚国之外，就是不知道其它两路大军怎么样了？”
陈长生刚刚从长生殿之中出来的时候，神念已经无限延伸出去，现在他的神念可以足足探测出去两千里。
这个已经是元婴初期的探测距离了。
马大帅道：“据我刚刚得到的消息，那两路大军似乎也在开始撤军，应该是受到中路大军的影响吧。”
陈长生暗暗点头，中路大军是主力，这次吃了这么大的败仗，等于是把他们打疼了，他们知道遇到了不可抵抗的强敌，要是再留下来，恐怕会吃更大的亏。
陈长生点点头，“好！那咱们班师回朝吧，马大帅，你在捷报上怎么说的。”
“我已经把这次胜利的过程详细写了进去，四皇子指挥得当，勇猛无敌，当属首功！”马大帅现在算是知道了，四皇子在邪月书生的帮助下，没准真的能够夺得皇位，哪里还不知道趁机拍马屁。

陈长生站起身来哈哈大笑拍了拍马大帅的肩膀，“马大帅果然才思敏捷，将来的前途绝对不可限量！”
马大帅立即露出欣喜之色，抱拳道：“马某甘愿做四殿下的不二忠臣，赴汤蹈火，在所不惜！”
这是开始表忠心了。
四皇子点点头，“马大帅忠心可嘉，日后定不负你，咱们回朝吧！”
当下，留下一部分兵力镇守死亡城，众人乘坐陈长生的造化飞舟回到了皇城。
此刻，太极殿之中，太子郝天看着前方传来的捷报有高兴，也有忧愁，高兴的是火罗国大军终于开始撤退，忧的是四皇子郝仁居然立下了如此大的功劳。
content_en:
Chen Changsheng looked at Qian Duoduo and was very shocked. Such a great master actually became so pious and repentant after being transformed.
I am afraid that even those who have practiced Buddhism for decades are not so pious. Only then do I realize how domineering and unpredictable the Buddhist techniques are. I must be more careful if I encounter them in the future.
However, Chen Changsheng was very happy to have conquered such a great master. He had another top master beside him.
"Qian Duoduo, from now on you will sit in the Palace of Eternal Life and help me deal with powerful enemies."
"Yes, Master, I will definitely help Master and wash away my sins as soon as possible."
When we came out of the Palace of Eternal Life, it was already bright. The sun had just peeked out of the sky, and its warm golden light shone on the City of Death, adding a bit of warmth.
The leaves of the sycamore tree in the yard have turned slightly yellow, bringing a sense of autumn.
"Mr. Xieyue, you have finally come out of seclusion. His Royal Highness and the Marshal asked you to go to the meeting hall after you come out of seclusion." As soon as Chen Changsheng came out, someone came forward and said.
"Okay!"
Chen Changsheng stepped out and entered the main hall.
Marshal Ma looked excited, "Sir, what a clever plan. As expected, the Fire Nation army retreated overnight and kept all the fire-scale horses. Our sergeants have already brought all the fire-scale horses over."
The fourth prince nodded with excitement, "This time we won a big victory and got more than 200,000 fire scale horses. This is a huge achievement!"
He didn't expect that this visit would go so smoothly, and he would achieve such a great victory with almost no effort. Of course, this was all because of the big boss Chen Changsheng.
Chen Changsheng nodded, "I already know this. The Huoluo Kingdom's middle army has retreated outside the Chu Kingdom. I just don't know what happened to the other two armies?"
When Chen Changsheng just came out of the Palace of Eternal Life, his spiritual thoughts had already extended infinitely. Now his spiritual thoughts can detect a distance of two thousand miles.
This is already the detection distance in the early stage of Nascent Soul.
Marshal Ma said: "According to the news I just received, the two armies seem to be starting to withdraw. It should be affected by the army in the middle."
Chen Changsheng nodded secretly. The army in the middle was the main force. They suffered such a big defeat this time, which was equivalent to hurting them. They knew that they had encountered an irresistible and powerful enemy. If they stayed, they would probably suffer even greater losses.
Chen Changsheng nodded, "Okay! Let's go back to the court, Marshal Ma. What did you say in the victory report?"
"I have written down the process of this victory in detail. The fourth prince commanded well and was invincible. He should be the first to achieve success!" Marshal Ma now knew that with the help of Scholar Xie Yue, the fourth prince might really be able to win the throne. He didn't know how to take advantage of the opportunity to flatter him.
Chen Changsheng stood up and laughed loudly and patted Marshal Ma on the shoulder, "As expected, Marshal Ma is very smart and his future is absolutely limitless!"
Marshal Ma immediately showed a look of joy, clasped his fists and said: "Ma is willing to be the loyal minister of His Highness the Fourth, through fire and water, no matter what!"
This is the beginning of showing loyalty.
The fourth prince nodded, "Marshal Ma is very loyal and will definitely live up to you in the future. Let's return to the court!"
At the moment, some troops were left to guard the City of Death, and everyone took Chen Changsheng's flying boat back to the imperial city.
At this moment, in the Taiji Hall, Prince Hao Tian was feeling happy and sad when he saw the good news coming from the front. He was happy that the Fire Kingdom army finally began to retreat, but he was worried that the fourth prince Hao Ren had actually made such a great contribution.
